sources.entry: streamlit - A framework which lets you build dashboards, generate reports, or create chat apps in minutes.

summary.one_liner: Streamlit is an open-source Python framework for turning scripts into interactive web apps such as dashboards, reports, and chat apps.
summary.what_it_does: Streamlit lets you build interactive web apps from Python scripts with little code. The README shows a short example: a script that creates a slider and writes its value and square, run with the streamlit run command. It includes input widgets, dataframes, charts, layout options, and multi-page apps. Apps update as the script is edited (live editing). Streamlit Components, created by a community of developers, extend the framework. The README also mentions Community Cloud for deploying and sharing apps.
use_cases: build a data dashboard in Python
turn a Python script into a web app
create an LLM or chatbot interface
share a data app with others
how_to_run: Create a file named streamlit_app.py with the example code from the README
notable: Live editing: the app updates as the script is edited
Pure Python API with no separate frontend code needed to build the app
Built-in Hello demo app via streamlit hello
caveats: The README says the project has paused accepting pull requests from outside the maintainer team; outside contributions are limited to bug reports, feature requests, and custom components
Community Cloud is offered for free per the README, but its limits are not described
